**`lib/response.js`** (they call it as `this.set(...)`):
- `res.links`, line 94
- `res.send`, lines 175, 199, 206, 223
- `res.json`, line 276
- `res.jsonp`, lines 320–321 and 331–332
- `res.type` (also exported as `res.contentType`; the function is named `contentType`), line 625
- `res.format`, line 699, inside a closure
- `res.attachment`, line 725
- `res.append`, line 756
- `res.location`, line 924
- `res.redirect`, line 982, inside a closure

**`lib/router/index.js`:**
- `sendOptionsResponse`, line 654: `res.set('Allow', body)`

**Left out:**
- `res.set` calls itself at line 798.
- All the `this.set(...)` calls in `lib/application.js` are `app.set`.
- Some methods, such as `res.cookie` (which calls `this.append`), reach `res.set` only through another method. I counted direct calls only.
